faqLeft.q: What engine does the Mercedes Viano 2.0 use?
faqLeft.a: The Viano 2.0 uses the M111 2.0-litre inline-four petrol engine, fitted across the entire W639 generation from 2003 to 2014.

faqLeft.q: How much does a Mercedes Viano 2.0 engine rebuild cost?
faqLeft.a: Rebuilds start from £2,200. Exact price depends on condition and parts required — submit your reg for a fixed-price quote.

faqLeft.q: Which engine code is fitted to my Viano 2.0?
faqLeft.a: Enter your registration on this page and we'll confirm you have the M111 before you're quoted anything.

faqLeft.q: Do you rebuild M111 Viano 2.0 engines?
faqLeft.a: Yes. We replace timing chain components, bearings and gaskets as standard on every Viano 2.0 rebuild.

faqRight.q: Do you supply used Viano 2.0 engines?
faqRight.a: Yes, in some cases a matched low-mileage used engine is the right option. Our team will advise honestly once we've matched your registration and understood your situation.

faqRight.q: Can you recover my Viano 2.0 if the engine has failed?
faqRight.a: Yes — nationwide recovery is available from £70, and most vehicles are collected within a few hours of booking.

faqRight.q: How long does a Viano 2.0 engine rebuild take?
faqRight.a: Most rebuilds are completed within 3-5 working days from the time your van arrives at our workshop.

faqRight.q: Is rebuilding better than fitting a used engine?
faqRight.a: For most Viano 2.0 owners, yes. A rebuild removes the compatibility risk that comes with an unknown used unit's history, and comes with a 12-month unlimited-mileage warranty — often longer and more comprehensive than what a used engine supplier offers.

form.guarantee: Most quotes returned within 30 minutes during working hours.
